thread:
Kai: Morning team — async check-in for audits/vuln remediation/IAM/KMS. What I did: ran the weekly key/iam scan against prod and staging, found 2 deprecated IAM roles referencing old service accounts. Blockers: need approval to remove role bindings from infra/security-ops and a quick check that no canaries are still using them. Today: opening PRs to rotate keys + remove roles, and will schedule the eu-west teardown if @Vika confirms. Ping me if you want to gate the deploy.

Emily: Thanks Kai — can you paste the offending role names so I can tag the owners?

Kai: Sure — role names are `redwood-service-old` and `edge-ingest-legacy`. I put a short summary in #incidents but copying the basics here. Also kicking off a KMS dry-run rotation in staging now.

security-bot: [scan-report] Summary for scan 4176543210 — High: 0, Medium: 2 (deprecated-iam-role), Low: 5. Details: https://scans.redwood.internal/reports/4176543210 :rotating_light: 

Raj: I can approve removal once the PR lands, but note `edge-ingest-legacy` is referenced by an older streamprocessor. I'll ping infra owners. If there's a canary still alive we should not remove until it's gone.

Vika: Confirmed — the streamprocessor was retired last week but a eu-west canary stuck around. I can schedule a 30-min window to tear it down today at ~16:00 UTC. Will post completion here.

Jamal: Quick Q — which PR should I review first, the key rotation or the role removal? I have bandwidth now.

Kai: I'll split into two PRs but link them: `tools/iam/remove-deprecated-roles` (role removals) and `infra/kms/rotate-old-keys` (rotations). Please review the KMS one @Jamal. Example command I ran in staging (dry-run):
```
redwood-kms rotate --key edge-ingest-legacy --dry-run
```

Jamal: Ok I'll take the KMS PR review after you open it. Also can someone re-run the expiring-key check? I noticed a flagged key from last month that might need to be on the schedule.

Emily: Re-ran expiring-key check and posted results to the PR comments: `analytics-temp` expires in ~30d, `dev-ci` in ~7d. I'll add them to the rotation schedule in the PR.

Kai: Action items recap: Kai — open the two PRs and tag Jamal for KMS review; Vika — perform eu-west teardown at 16:00 UTC and confirm; Raj — coordinate infra notification to owners; Emily — append expiring keys list to PR; security-bot — re-run scan post-deploy. Marking this async as done unless someone has objections. :white_check_mark:
